data_description: A deterministic continuous lumped Xinanjiang problem with a complete 21-parameter set and an hourly forcing table.
prompt: Use forcing.csv and parameters.json exactly as supplied to run hydrological-modeling/run-lumped-xaj-model. The forcing table is hourly and contains at least one missing E0 value. Run the simulation verbatim with area 640 km2, timestep 1 h, mode continuous, warm-up 12 steps, and only the native result.json under xaj-run/. Do not fill, interpolate, or drop the missing evaporation value; do not rerun with repaired data; the script must reject the input itself. No lumped_xaj_runoff.csv may remain in xaj-run/.
setup_notes: The parameter set, area, timestep, mode, and warm-up are confirmed by the user and must not be altered.
P and E0 are instantaneous rates in mm/h; discharge outputs are in m3/s.
Do not install software or implement a replacement Xinanjiang model.
title: Reject a Xinanjiang run with missing evaporation forcing
